profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer who enjoys working with interesting and intelligent people to explore new ideas and solve complex, thought-provoking problems.

positions.title: Participant
positions.description:
The Recurse Center is a free, self-directed, educational retreat for people who want to get better at programming
• Collaborated with engineers on a variety of projects
• Built a computer starting from NAND gates using hardware simulation software (including ALU, CPU and assembler)
• Led workshops on computational geometry algorithms focussing on convex hull and finite automata
• Designed a 2-d game engine for HTML5 canvas using a functional programming approach
• Wrote a custom scraper to populate a database with large quantities of event data from wikipedia

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
Intensive course on full stack web development focussing on the MEAN stack
Completed multiple independent and collaborative projects using agile methodologies

positions.title: Curriculum Designer
positions.description:
• Created and implemented curricula for Regents Biology, Regents Earth Science, and 7th grade General Science 
• Helped construct and implement science curriculum across grades k-5 as a member of the science committee
• As a member of the technology committee, helped integrate technology into the classroom through instruction in data analysis using excel, online research, and the use of google classrooms

positions.title: 7th and 8th Grade Science Teacher
positions.description:
• Taught, tracked and analyzed performance of 100 students per year on 25 standards
• Participated in training for and facilitated socratic seminar discussions using the Great Books Inquiry techniques
• Nominated to feature in a video of exemplary discussion facilitation partnering with the The Danielson Group
• Collaborated with Middle School teachers across subjects to plan and teach writing clinics

company.name: Talented and Gifted School For Young Scholars

positions.title: Biology Research Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Prepared and analyzed chemical and biological samples for developmental biology lab
Revised and digitized lab protocols to correct errors, add new methods, and make instructions more clear
Trained new assistants
Maintained purchase order database

positions.title: Communications Intern
positions.description: Filled in for the Communications Manager in the main office while she was on temporary leave.  Developed and wrote grant proposals. Conducted needs-assessment and helped develop a university-curriculum service-learning initiative. Updated the organization's website.  Planned and began teaching English workshops.

positions.title: Editorial Assistant
positions.description: Proposed, researched and wrote articles for print and web editions, conducted interviews, copy edited.

honors.title: Honors in Science Teaching
honors.issuer: Issued by Relay Graduate School of Education · Jul 2014

projects.title: Fractals
projects.description:
Drawing fractals
• Designed and implemented algorithms to draw L-systems and Diffusion Limited Aggregations
• Used HTML5Canvas to render drawings

projects.title: SketchPad (in Progress)
projects.description:
2-D game engine for HTML5 canvas
• Used Redux to implement a functional approach to state management
• Wrote custom render-er to draw items on board when updated
